mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log (transaction_id, operator_id, operator_name, operation, detail, ip_address, created_at) VALUES (#{transactionId}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{operation}, #{detail}, #{ipAddress}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, transaction_id AS transactionId, operator_id AS operatorId, operator_name AS operatorName, operation, detail, ip_address AS ipAddress, created_at AS createdAt FROM audit_log WHERE transaction_id = #{transactionId} ORDER BY created_at, id
